ModMetaData.name: Rework Reforjed
ModMetaData.author: DGZ
ModMetaData.description: Pre-load patching framework for RimWorld (Reforjed series). Rewrites Assembly-CSharp.dll in memory using Mono.Cecil before the game loads it — no disk modifications. Enables full content creation from C# without XML: recipes, incidents, jobs, needs, quests, traits, genes, and more. Target: RimWorld 1.6.4850 rev646.
